messages.content: "請問您能否根據五因素模型和邁爾斯-布里格斯性格分類法（MBTI）分析我的個性？就五因素模型而言，請考慮我很健談，不容易緊張，有許多藝術興趣，不懶惰，並且很寬容。就MBTI而言，我的偏好更傾向於感覺而非思考，比起內向我覺得自己更外向，我更傾向於知覺而非判斷，最後我偏好直覺而非感覺。"

function.name: MBTI_analyse
function.description: Analyse personality based on the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) which sorts for preferences and generates a 4-letter personality type. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

thinking_vs_feeling.description: Preference of user between thinking and feeling.

introverted_vs_extroverted.description: Preference of user between introverted and extroverted.

judging_vs_perceiving.description: Preference of user between judging and perceiving.

sensing_vs_intuition.description: Preference of user between sensing and intuition.

function.name: five_factor_model_analyse
function.description: Analyse personality based on the five-factor model, also known as the Big Five, which measures openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness, and neuroticism. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

talkative.description: Indicates if the user is talkative.

nervous.description: Indicates if the user gets nervous easily.

artistic_interests.description: Indicates if the user has many artistic interests.

lazy.description: Indicates if the user tends to be lazy.

forgiving.description: Indicates if the user is forgiving.

message.reasoning:
The user wants an analysis of their personality using both the Five Factor Model and MBTI. They provide specific preferences: For Five Factor Model: talkative, not nervous, many artistic interests, not lazy, forgiving. For MBTI: preference for feeling over thinking, extroverted over introverted, perceiving over judging, intuition over sensing. Wait they said "I prefer intuition over sensing" but earlier they said "I prefer intuition over sensing"? Actually they said "最後我偏好直覺而非感覺" which means "Finally I prefer intuition over sensing." But earlier they said "偏好更傾向於感覺而非思考" meaning "prefer feeling over thinking". So we have to interpret: Thinking vs Feeling: they prefer feeling. Introverted vs Extroverted: they prefer extroverted. Judging vs Perceiving: they prefer perceiving. Sensing vs Intuition: they prefer intuition. So MBTI type would be ENFP? Wait: Extraverted (E), Intuitive (N), Feeling (F), Perceiving (P). That is ENFP. Yes.

Now we need to call the function for MBTI analysis with those preferences. Then call the function for Five Factor Model analysis with the given boolean values: talkative true, nervous false, artistic_interests true, lazy false, forgiving true. Then produce a combined analysis. The user wants an analysis. We should call the functions accordingly. The function names: MBTI_analyse and five_factor_model_analyse. We'll call them.
